result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both pages are self-contained and use only a system sans plus a monospace face. Answer A sets the shipment IDs, dock doors and ETAs in monospace, so every numeric column lines up exactly and 0/O and 1/l can't be confused. Its status badges are told apart by colour, icon shape and label, which helps when reading from across a room. Answer B uses monospace only for the IDs: its ETAs and door numbers are in the proportional sans, and its status pills differ by colour and label but share the same dot icon, so it is slightly weaker for scanning at a distance. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers use a system sans with a monospace face for shipment IDs, and neither adds a decorative or branded typeface. B also sets the dock doors and ETAs in monospace, so the times line up as a clean column and the characters stay unambiguous; its statuses differ by icon shape as well as color and label. A's ETAs are in proportional sans, which still line up reasonably, but its status pills depend on color alone apart from the text.
